diff --git a/draftlab/tests/test_alpha_known.py b/draftlab/tests/test_alpha_known.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e62812a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/draftlab/tests/test_alpha_known.py
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+"""Known answers for the alpha metric (CLAUDE.md "Known answers"), on the real
+0.5B checkpoint. Skipped only if models/ has not been fetched."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from draftlab.eval.alpha import JaxModel, NGramDrafter, alpha_and_greedy, load_blocks
+
+MODEL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "models" / "qwen2.5-0.5b"
+HAS_MODEL = (MODEL / "config.json").exists()
+needs_model = pytest.mark.skipif(not HAS_MODEL, reason="models/ not fetched")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def tok():
+    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+    return AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def target():
+    return JaxModel.from_path(MODEL, max_len=512)
+
+
+@needs_model
+def test_per_position_ce_matches_hf_labels_loss(target, tok):
+    """JaxModel rows must be aligned (row i predicts token i+1): per-position CE
+    from dists == HF per-token NLL, and their mean == model(ids, labels=ids).loss."""
+    import torch
+    from torch.nn import functional as F
+    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
+
+    hf = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODEL, torch_dtype=torch.float32).eval()
+    for b in load_blocks("val", max_tokens=256, n_blocks=2):
+        ids = torch.tensor([tok.encode(b["text"], add_special_tokens=False)])
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            out = hf(ids, labels=ids)
+            nll = F.cross_entropy(hf(ids).logits[0, :-1], ids[0][1:], reduction="none").numpy()
+        p, valid = target.dists([], ids[0].tolist())
+        assert not valid[0] and valid[1:].all()
+        arr = ids[0].numpy()[1:]  # ce_j = -log p[j, ids[j]] for j >= 1
+        ce = -np.log(np.maximum(p.astype(np.float64)[np.arange(1, len(arr) + 1), arr], 1e-30))
+        assert np.max(np.abs(ce - nll)) < 1e-3, np.max(np.abs(ce - nll))
+        assert abs(float(ce.mean()) - out.loss.item()) < 1e-3
+
+
+@needs_model
+def test_target_top1_on_val_in_sanity_range(target, tok):
+    """Qwen2.5-0.5B top-1 next-token accuracy on corpus val blocks is 40-70%
+    (57.5% measured on 372 tok); under 20% means an alignment bug."""
+    hits = tot = 0
+    for b in load_blocks("val", max_tokens=256, n_blocks=40):
+        ids = np.asarray(tok.encode(b["text"], add_special_tokens=False))
+        p, valid = target.dists([], ids.tolist())
+        ok = valid & (p.argmax(axis=-1) == ids)
+        hits += int(ok.sum())
+        tot += int(valid.sum())
+    acc = hits / tot
+    assert 0.40 <= acc <= 0.70, f"top-1 {acc:.3f} outside sanity range 0.40-0.70"
+
+
+@needs_model
+def test_uniform_q_alpha_exact(target, tok):
+    """q uniform -> alpha = sum_x min(p, 1/V) = 1 - TV(p, u) = 1 - 0.5*sum|p - 1/V|
+    (checked via the independent total-variation identity, not the same min-sum)."""
+    ids = np.asarray(tok.encode(load_blocks("val", 256, 1)[0]["text"], add_special_tokens=False))
+    p, valid = target.dists([], ids.tolist())
+    v = p.shape[1]
+    a, _ = alpha_and_greedy(p, np.full_like(p, 1.0 / v))
+    expected = 1.0 - 0.5 * np.abs(p.astype(np.float64) - 1.0 / v).sum(axis=-1)
+    assert np.max(np.abs(a - expected)) < 1e-6
+    assert (a >= 1.0 / v - 1e-6).all() and (a <= 1.0).all()  # TV bounds
+
+
+def test_ngram_repeated_block_planted_effect():
+    """Planted effect: a block repeated verbatim after itself -> ngram acceptance
+    on the copy ~= 1 (all but the first position, which has no prior context)."""
+    x = list(range(1, 65))  # no internal n-gram repeats, so every proposal is exact
+    d = NGramDrafter(vocab_size=1000)
+    q, valid = d.dists(x, x)
+    match = valid & (q.argmax(axis=-1) == np.asarray(x))
+    assert match.sum() == len(x) - 1 and match[1:].all()
+
+
+def test_ngram_shuffled_block_null_control():
+    """Null control: the same tokens shuffled within the block -> ngram acceptance
+    collapses (proposals were learned on the original order)."""
+    x = list(range(1, 65))
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
+    y = [x[i] for i in rng.permutation(len(x))]
+    d = NGramDrafter(vocab_size=1000)
+    q, valid = d.dists(x, y)
+    acc = float((valid & (q.argmax(axis=-1) == np.asarray(y))).mean())
+    assert acc < 0.5, f"shuffled acceptance {acc:.3f} did not collapse"

+def test_temperature_scaling_chi_square():
+    """T=0.7: first-token distribution == softmax(logits/0.7), chi2 p > 0.01,
+    and distinguishable from the unscaled softmax (so the test fails if the
+    temperature is ignored)."""
+    from scipy.special import logsumexp
+
+    cfg, params = _tiny16(1)
+    prompt = [i % 7 for i in range(32)]
+    lg, _ = M.prefill(cfg, params, prompt, len(prompt) + 8)
+    lg = np.asarray(lg[-1], np.float64)
+    pT = np.exp(lg / 0.7 - logsumexp(lg / 0.7))
+    p1 = np.exp(lg - logsumexp(lg))
+    assert float(np.abs(pT - p1).sum()) > 0.05, "guard: T=0.7 must change the distribution"
+    N = 8000
+    obs = np.zeros(cfg.vocab_size, np.int64)
+    for i in range(N):
+        dec = SpecDecoder(cfg, params, NGramDrafter(cfg.vocab_size, max_n=4),
+                          max_len=len(prompt) + 8, k=2, temperature=0.7, seed=i)
+        out, _ = dec.generate(prompt, 1)
+        obs[out[0]] += 1
+    exp = N * pT
+    chi2 = float(((obs - exp) ** 2 / exp).sum())
+    pval = float(stats.chi2.sf(chi2, df=cfg.vocab_size - 1))
+    assert pval > 0.01, f"chi2={chi2:.1f}, p={pval:.4g} (not sampling softmax(lg/0.7))"

+HELDOUT_RAW = ROOT / "data/raw/heldout_turns.jsonl"
+
+
+def build_heldout(raw_path: Path = HELDOUT_RAW, out_dir: Path = OUT_DIR, tok=None) -> int:
+    """Temporal hold-out: runs exported after the corpus (tools/export_traces.py
+    --since) -> data/corpus/heldout.parquet. Drops runs already in a split and
+    blocks whose (kind, text) occurs in any split, so no drafter saw them."""
+    import pyarrow as pa
+    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+
+    if tok is None:
+        from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(TOKENIZER_DIR)
+    old_runs: set[str] = set()
+    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+    for name in ("train", "val", "test"):
+        t = pq.read_table(out_dir / f"{name}.parquet", columns=["run", "kind", "text"]).to_pydict()
+        old_runs.update(t["run"])
+        seen.update(zip(t["kind"], t["text"], strict=True))
+    rs = []
+    for r in expand(load_raw(raw_path)):
+        if r["run"] in old_runs:
+            continue
+        ids = tok.encode(r["text"])
+        if len(ids) < MIN_TOKENS:
+            continue
+        text = tok.decode(ids[:MAX_TOKENS]) if len(ids) > MAX_TOKENS else r["text"]
+        key = (r["kind"], text)
+        if key in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(key)
+        rs.append({**r, "text": text, "n_tokens": min(len(ids), MAX_TOKENS)})
+    if not rs:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"no new blocks in {raw_path}")
+    cols = ["run", "project", "seq", "role", "kind", "tool", "text", "n_tokens"]
+    pq.write_table(pa.table({c: [r[c] for r in rs] for c in cols}), out_dir / "heldout.parquet")
+    print(f"heldout: {len(rs)} blocks, {len({r['run'] for r in rs})} runs "
+          f"-> {out_dir / 'heldout.parquet'}")
+    return len(rs)
+
+

 RESULTS_DIR = ROOT / "results"

index 0000000..d8176db
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/bench_speedup.py
@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+"""Head-to-head CPU speedup: each config vs `none` on the same prompts, one process,
+nothing else running. A warm-up pass compiles every shape; then `--reps` passes
+run the configs interleaved (none, A, B, ..., none, A, B, ...), so drift hits all
+configs alike. Speedup per rep = none wall / config wall over the same prompts.
+
+    python tools/bench_speedup.py            # -> results/speedup_bench.json
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+from draftlab.jaxlm import model as M  # noqa: E402
+from draftlab.jaxlm import spec as S  # noqa: E402
+from draftlab.sweep import (  # noqa: E402
+    CKPT,
+    LORA_BASE,
+    MODELS,
+    RESULTS,
+    load_prompts,
+    merge_adapter,
+)
+
+# (target, drafter, k, temperature)
+CONFIGS = [
+    ("qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct", "ngram", 8, 0.0),
+    ("qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct", "ngram", 8, 0.0),
+    ("qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct", "lora", 2, 0.0),
+    ("qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct", "lora", 4, 0.0),
+    ("qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct", "lora", 4, 0.7),
+]
+
+
+def _drafter(name, tcfg, max_len, cache):
+    if name == "none":
+        return S.NullDrafter()
+    if name == "ngram":
+        return S.NGramDrafter(tcfg.vocab_size)
+    if name not in cache:
+        dcfg, dp = M.load_safetensors(LORA_BASE)
+        cache[name] = (dcfg, merge_adapter(dp, dcfg, CKPT / ("lora" if name == "lora" else "dpo")))
+    dcfg, dp = cache[name]
+    return S.ModelDrafter(dcfg, dp, max_len)
+
+
+def _pass(tcfg, tp, prompts, drafter, k, temp, n_gen, max_len, cache):
+    wall = drafted = acc = steps = toks = 0
+    for p in prompts:
+        dec = S.SpecDecoder(tcfg, tp, _drafter(drafter, tcfg, max_len, cache), max_len,
+                            k=k if drafter != "none" else 0, temperature=temp, seed=p["i"])
+        t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        out, st = dec.generate(p["ids"], n_gen)
+        wall += time.perf_counter() - t0
+        toks += len(out)
+        steps += len(st)
+        drafted += sum(s.drafted for s in st)
+        acc += sum(s.accepted for s in st)
+    return {"wall_s": wall, "tok_s": toks / wall, "tokens_per_step": toks / steps,
+            "accept": acc / drafted if drafted else None}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--n-per-kind", type=int, default=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--n-gen", type=int, default=32)
+    ap.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(RESULTS / "speedup_bench.json"))
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    out: dict = {"n_gen": a.n_gen, "reps": a.reps, "split": "heldout", "targets": {}}
+    for target in dict.fromkeys(c[0] for c in CONFIGS):
+        tdir = MODELS / target
+        prompts = load_prompts("heldout", a.n_per_kind, 128, tdir)
+        max_len = max(len(p["ids"]) for p in prompts) + a.n_gen + 16
+        tcfg, tp = M.load_safetensors(tdir)
+        cache: dict = {}
+        cfgs = [c for c in CONFIGS if c[0] == target]
+        temps = sorted({c[3] for c in cfgs})
+        runs = [("none", 0, t) for t in temps] + [(d, k, t) for _, d, k, t in cfgs]
+        print(f"{target}: {len(prompts)} prompts, {len(runs)} configs", flush=True)
+        for d, k, t in runs:  # warm-up: compile every prompt/step shape
+            _pass(tcfg, tp, prompts, d, k, t, a.n_gen, max_len, cache)
+        reps = {f"{d}-k{k}-T{t}": [] for d, k, t in runs}
+        for r in range(a.reps):
+            for d, k, t in runs:
+                res = _pass(tcfg, tp, prompts, d, k, t, a.n_gen, max_len, cache)
+                reps[f"{d}-k{k}-T{t}"].append(res)
+                print(f"  rep {r} {d} k={k} T={t}: {res['tok_s']:.2f} tok/s", flush=True)
+        rows = {}
+        for d, k, t in runs:
+            key = f"{d}-k{k}-T{t}"
+            base = reps[f"none-k0-T{t}"]
+            sp = [b["wall_s"] / x["wall_s"] for b, x in zip(base, reps[key], strict=True)]
+            rows[key] = {
+                "drafter": d, "k": k, "temp": t,
+                "tok_s": float(np.mean([x["tok_s"] for x in reps[key]])),
+                "speedup": float(np.mean(sp)), "speedup_range": [float(min(sp)), float(max(sp))],
+                "accept": reps[key][0]["accept"],
+                "tokens_per_step": reps[key][0]["tokens_per_step"],
+            }
+        out["targets"][target] = {"n_prompts": len(prompts), "configs": rows}
+    Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def test_eos_stops_generation():
+    """A token in tokenizer.eos_ids ends the completion (excluded, finish 'stop')."""
+    cfg = M.Qwen2Cfg.from_hf(tiny_config())
+    params = M.init_params(cfg, jax.random.PRNGKey(0))
+    tok = ToyTokenizer()

+    full = c.post("/v1/chat/completions", json=_body(model="tiny+none")).json()
+    text = full["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    # ToyTokenizer.decode maps id -> chr(33 + id % 90); mark the 4th token's ids as EOS
+    stop_ch = text[3]
+    tok.eos_ids = frozenset(i for i in range(tok.vocab_size) if chr(33 + i % 90) == stop_ch)
